summary: High-speed pursuit of a silver Nissan Altima with an unlicensed driver. Speeds reached roughly 110 mph with light traffic on the Westside Parkway before the driver reversed course eastbound. CHP took over the chase near the Allen Road area after air support was unavailable.

Physical fight involving a firearm reported at a restaurant on Rosedale Highway. A second caller reported another man armed with a gun in his waistband. Parties fled westbound in a black Dodge Challenger before officers arrived.
Collision near railroad tracks with a patient pinned in a vehicle. Multiple engines and a red trauma activation responded; crews worked to free the patient, a man in his 40s with a head injury.
Catalytic converter theft reported. Three masked suspects in a black BMW took a converter and possibly a gunshot was heard in the area after the theft. Patrol investigating.

area: Panama Road & Tejon Avenue, south Kern County
summary: Vehicle accident with one person pinned in the Panama Road and Tejon Avenue area. Multiple engines and a battalion chief responded.
Man in his 30s with traumatic injuries at the Amtrak station; an ambulance was called code 3 for transport.
Subject found breathing but cold to the touch with no Narcan available at a residence in the Boron area. Medical units responded.
Deputies and fire responded to a report of a man threatening to jump from a Highway 99 overpass near White Lane.
Welfare check on a juvenile in possession of a blade with intent to self-harm. Units were unable to make contact at the first location and were redirected to a nearby address.
Audible alarm reported on Buena Vista Road; crews checked the location.
